subject: MAP draft + proposed signature window — ClearView (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@clearview.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, ClearView Procurement <procurement@clearview.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + proposed signature window — ClearView (post-demo recap)

Hi Sophie — great demo today, thanks for the time. Per our call Im attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short checklist of dependencies to make the procurement window realistic. Key asks below.

Quick recap (short):
- Goal: Redwood hosted API + Dedicated capacity for subject-search pipeline (3x throughput target).
- Target commercial close: we discussed the end of August / start of September; Im proposing an internal target signature date of 2026-08-31 to allow provisioning the Dedicated pool for a 9/6 start.

Draft MAP milestones (attached: ClearView_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Contract redlines reviewed by ClearView legal — responsibility: ClearView (Sophie + procurement). Target: 2026-08-25.
2) SOC2 evidence & security questionnaire completed — responsibility: Redwood (Vivek to provide package). Target: 2026-08-26.
3) Final SOW sign-off and technical acceptance criteria — joint owners (Laura + Sophie). Target: 2026-08-28.
4) PO issued and countersigned contract — responsibility: ClearView procurement. Target signature date: 2026-08-31 (we can move to 9/3 if needed).

Dependencies / blockers:
- SOC2 artifact timestamps (we can provide the summarized export but legal occasionally asks for the packaged zip).
- Any unusual redlines on data residency / logging (we flagged a few items during call).
- Order of operations: we need signed contract or PO to schedule Dedicated GPU pool and procurement to provision the required instance types.

Proposed next steps:
- Sophie: confirm whether 8/31 signature is achievable (or preferred fallbacks).
- Procurement: share any PO template / invoice cadence we should mirror.
- Vivek: I asked you to prepare the SOC2 evidence summary and a short security slide we can attach to the MAP.

Ill hold a 20-min alignment call if theres divergence on dates. If youre comfortable with this timeline, Ill update the MAP and route it to DocuSign.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: ClearView_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (PDF summary)

From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@clearview.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearView Procurement <procurement@clearview.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + proposed signature window — ClearView (post-demo recap)

Laura — thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Were in review with legal. 8/25 for redlines is optimistic but possible if we prioritize. Ill flag with our counsel.
- Procurement typically needs at least 5 business days from signed SOW to process a PO (internal policy). That would push the earliest possible provisioning if we sign 8/31 to roughly 9/7-9/8.
- For SOC2, please include a consolidated file with control owners and dates; the summary PDF is helpful.

If Redwood needs Dedicated capacity in the first week of Sept, our team can escalate the PO processing but wed prefer a firm signature before 9/3. Realistically, can Redwood tolerate a 9/7 start if we confirm the PO issuance timeframe?

Sophie Tran
Head of Product Operations | ClearView AI
Sophie.tran@clearview.ai

Thanks — quick status from engineering/security side:

- I can assemble a SOC2 evidence bundle and the short technical summary by 2026-08-25 (will attach a zip of artifacts and a control-owner table). That should satisfy most procurement legal asks; I noted one Q about retention windows that Ill clarify in the summary.
- On the redlines: Marcus is managing contract responses on our side (marcus_lin@redwood.ai). Marcus, if theres anything in the draft that looks like it needs alternate language (data residency / audit rights), can you flag ownership?

Also, if ClearView is flexible on the signature date, launching the Dedicated pool is cheaper if we can provision on 9/6 (end-of-week GPU availability) vs 9/1. If 9/7 is the realistic procurement processing finish, that aligns well with our capacity planning.

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie / Laura — I reviewed the MAP and the contract draft. A couple of practical notes:

- We will accept a target signature date of 2026-09-02 to accommodate your PO processing timeline, with the expectation that ClearView issues a notice to proceed and the PO within 48 hours of signature. That moves our provisioning to the week of 9/6.
- Marcus/Redwood will prep a brief redline summary and proposed alternate wording for the three clauses we flagged (data residency, audit access, liability cap). Ill aim to have that back to Sophie by 2026-08-26 EOD so your legal can review promptly.
- Vivek, I appreciate the SOC2 bundle ETA — once I have the control-owner table Ill update the MAP milestones to reflect the slight date shifts below.

Updated high-level MAP (agreed):
- Redlines in by 2026-08-26 (ClearView legal to confirm)
- SOC2 bundle delivered by Redwood by 2026-08-25
- SOW sign-off by 2026-08-28
- Signature date target: 2026-09-02 (final fallback from 8/31)

Sophie — can you confirm acceptance of 2026-09-02 as the mutual signature target so I can update the DocuSign envelope and send to both parties?

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
